summary: Router 0.42.2 implements the TM-03 next action (ADR-0128, proposed, supersedes ADR-0065): the control UI runs no inline script. The page's script moved unchanged from ui.html into router/ui.js (served at /ui.js), and its 68 inline event handlers (20 in ui.html, 48 built by the script with js()) became named actions: elements carry data-click/data-change/data-input and data-args (a JSON array built by args() = esc(JSON.stringify(...)) or data-arg (one fixed string in static markup); one listener per event type, capture phase on the document, walks ev.composedPath() from the target and calls ACTIONS[name](el, ...args), only for names ACTIONS owns (Object.hasOwn; 'constructor', 'toString', '__proto__' are refused, checked in a browser). The control port's CSP is script-src 'self' (no 'unsafe-inline', no 'unsafe-eval'); style-src keeps 'unsafe-inline' (47 style attributes; documented as residual). Traced B1/B2: /ui.js is a fixed path to a fixed file (no name from the request, no traversal), registered on the control app behind basic_auth_middleware like '/' (only /v1/ is exempt; refused without login, tested), Cache-Control no-store and the control headers. Values from node, model, role, client and setting data reach handlers only as JSON values parsed from an HTML-escaped attribute; nothing is concatenated into code. Mechanical equivalence was checked: all 44 changed script lines are identical to the old ones apart from the handler attributes, the other differences are the header comment, args() replacing js(), the dispatcher and a removed unused variable; static handlers in ui.html were replaced by exact matches. One deliberate behaviour difference: settings actions pass the raw setting path instead of the HTML-escaped one (identical for all existing paths, which contain no &<>"'; before, listToggle would have failed for such a path). Residual: injected markup (should an escape be missed) can still name one of the fixed actions, which then needs an operator click (and the confirmation for revoking); before, it could run arbitrary script without a click. install.sh refuses a source folder without ui.js; deploy.py and the Dockerfile ship it; selftest_container_image derives the image's files from install.sh. No configuration key, API field, secret or data path changes.

findings.evidence: The first version of the dispatcher looked up ACTIONS[name] directly, so data-click="constructor" or "toString" reached inherited Object methods (harmless calls, but not the listed actions).
findings.resolution: The dispatcher accepts only Object.hasOwn(ACTIONS, name) and logs anything else; selftest_browser.py asserts the guard; in a browser 'constructor', 'toString' and '__proto__' were refused while the real actions still ran.

tests.evidence: 10 tests OK: script-src exactly 'self'; /ui.js 200 with login, text/javascript, no-store, control headers; /ui.js and /admin/state 401 without login (rejected case); no inline handler or inline script in ui.html or in the markup ui.js builds (the same patterns find all 68 handlers and the inline script in origin/main's ui.html); every data-args is ${args(...)}; every named action exists and every action is named; capture-phase listener and the hasOwn guard present; nothing evaluated as code; nothing loaded from elsewhere.

tests.command: browser (built-in pane) against python test/dev_env.py, CSP and rejected cases
tests.evidence: Served CSP default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; ... Injected , a button with onclick and an inline

tests.command: browser against test/dev_env.py, every UI action
tests.evidence: 66 checks: 39 with the called functions replaced by recorders (each click action's arguments; setChange for numOrNull, checked, textOrNull, boolOrNull with their conversions; all nine nodePolicy fields; modelField, listToggle, setDecN, renderDecisions on change and input), 16 on CFG (tier model with re-render, num_ctx, busy_ok; latency_first 1/0/empty; priority; moveTier; canary add, fields, remove; addTier, delTier; the #roles listener still marks the roles dirty after the action), 11 with real calls (pending setting then reset; rotate secret then copy; approve node then revoke with cancel and confirm; update, delete and client actions with arguments containing \"'<& intact). Language switch to German and back works.
end-to-end suite: 337 PASS, 0 failures (before the hasOwn guard, which touches only ui.js).

tests.command: every python command of the python job in .github/workflows/ci.yml (Windows), except pip install, run_tests.py and check_public_changes
tests.evidence: 94 commands, 0 failed (before the hasOwn guard; selftest_browser.py rerun afterwards: OK). selftest_install.py skips its Linux-only cases on Windows; CI runs them.
run after staging this record; added lines reviewed by hand: code, synthetic test values, documentation.

limitations: 'unsafe-inline' remains for styles: injected markup can still change how the page looks.
Injected markup could still name one of the fixed UI actions; it would need an operator click (and the confirmation for revoking).
The browser checks ran in the built-in Chromium-based pane only, not in Firefox or Safari; Object.hasOwn and composedPath need a browser from 2021 or later.

The node update buttons (agent and Ollama) were checked with elements built by args() as the template does, since the development environment has no pending update; their template lines are mechanically identical to the old ones apart from the attributes.
No design document covers the control UI; ADR-0128 and browser_headers.py describe the mechanism.
